verdict.rationale: Ultrametric documents an HTTP API reference for reading process guides and working with company context, with a downloadable OpenAPI contract. Concurrency and idempotency are documented through revisions and update keys, and paging uses `nextCursor`. A hosted MCP server and a JSON-mode CLI round out programmatic access. The probe's 404s were only at generic OpenAPI paths, not the documented /contracts/openapi.json, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the OpenAPI contract and HTTP endpoints work, and endpoint-level detail in the evidence (auth flow for HTTP, full read/write coverage). [2026-10-14 adversarial bias audit (owner-product refresh lane): quality re-capped 8 -> 6, restoring the 2026-10-08 audit. The upgrade's load-bearing sentence ("the 404s were only at generic OpenAPI paths, not the documented /contracts/openapi.json, so they do not contradict the claim") is affirmatively false: the documented path was fetched on 2026-10-08 and re-fetched on 2026-10-14 and answers 404 ({"code":"NOT_FOUND"} on api.ultrametric.ai, "Asset not found" on docs.ultrametric.ai). anthropic-skills' full 8 is the bar for a corroborated public API; the owner's docs claims minus the contradicted contract and with no authenticated call stay at 6. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
